result.summary: Found 4 issues: mainly layout truncation and minor visual inconsistencies on the food delivery app home screen.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal scroll section cuts off the third restaurant card (Trattoria Piccolo) abruptly at the screen edge, with the name and price truncated/hidden.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade gradient or partial peek indicator at the edge to signal scrollability, or ensure card content isn't cut mid-text.

issues.description: The promotional banner text ('3 free deliveries for you' and subtext) has low contrast against the light green background, making it harder to read.
issues.suggestion: Increase text color contrast or darken the banner background slightly for better readability.

issues.description: The category filter row (Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) is cut off on the right edge, hiding additional category options without a clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add a visual cue (fade/arrow) indicating more categories are scrollable to the right.

issues.description: The pizza promotional image at the bottom of the screen is abruptly cut off by the navigation bar, with no visible restaurant name or details before the cutoff.
issues.suggestion: Ensure card content isn't cropped by the bottom nav; add proper spacing or lazy-load indicator.
